interface.signature: def longestKSubstr(S: str, K: int) -> int:

preconditions.expression: isinstance(S, str) and 1 <= len(S) <= 10**5 and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in S)
preconditions.description: S is a non-empty string of lowercase Latin letters with length between 1 and 10^5.
K is an integer between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.description: The return value is either -1 (no valid substring exists) or a positive integer representing the length of the longest substring with exactly K distinct characters.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(substr) <= len(S) and len(set(substr)) == K for substr in [S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1) if S[i:j] and len(set(S[i:j])) == K]) and (return_value == -1 or return_value == max(len(substr) for substr in [S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1) if S[i:j] and len(set(S[i:j])) == K] if return_value != -1))
postconditions.description: The return value is the length of the longest substring in S with exactly K distinct characters, or -1 if no such substring exists.
